item.title: Welcome to My Blog
item.description:
Welcome to My Blog

This is a demo blog post written in your Obsidian vault and published through Hugo!

How This Works

This post lives in your Obsidian vault at posts/public-blog/posts/ and is automatically available to Hugo through a symlink in the content/posts directory.

Benefits of This Setup

  • Write in Obsidian: Use all your favorite Obsidian features like backlinks, templates, and plugins
  • Publish with Hugo: Automatically sync your public posts to your Hugo site
  • Organized workflow: Keep your private notes separate from public blog posts
